front.title: Mistral's new 1T model aims to leapfrog closed and open rivals
front.tldr: French lab Mistral released Mistral Large 4, a trillion-parameter model with 49 billion active parameters, aimed at matching the best of OpenAI, Google and Chinese rivals.

front.title: Apple's smart home push includes LG-made doorbell, lock, thermostat
front.tldr: Bloomberg reports Apple is working with LG on devices, sensors and cameras for its coming smart home push. It is a report, not yet confirmed by Apple.

front.title: Jaguar "inaugurates a new era" with Type 01 electric car
front.tldr: Jaguar has unveiled the Type 01, an electric car with thin headlights, a long bonnet and a rear-leaning stance designed to stand apart from homogenous EVs.

stories.title: Sharing AI progress in mathematics
stories.tldr: OpenAI published new results on open problems in mathematics from an internal frontier model, sharing Lean proof formalisations and research details on GitHub.

stories.title: Anthropic is giving startups a free year of Claude Team and $1,000 in credits
stories.tldr: Anthropic says the benefits of AI will reach most people through companies building on top of models, not the models alone, hence the free year and credits for startups.

stories.title: EmbeddingGemma 2: an open, lightweight multimodal embedding model
stories.tldr: Google DeepMind released EmbeddingGemma 2, a small multimodal embedding model under the Apache 2.0 licence, a notably permissive choice for this kind of model.

stories.title: Hark releases an AI personal assistant with a focus on privacy
stories.tldr: Hark's new personal assistant is designed to compete with Muse, Dots and Instinct by putting privacy first.

stories.title: Bluesky wants to give you your own domain on the open web
stories.tldr: Bluesky is working on letting users claim their own domain as a handle, though the company says the process will still take 18 to 24 months.

stories.title: Doom on the Vectrex turns the classic shooter into Tron-like vector art
stories.tldr: A developer ported Doom to the 1982 Vectrex console, rendering the classic shooter as glowing vector line art, with some processing caveats.

stories.title: Emmys will move from broadcast TV to Prime Video in 2027
stories.tldr: The Emmy Awards will shift from broadcast television to Prime Video from 2027, letting non-Amazon-Prime subscribers watch via the platform too.

stories.title: Remember MapQuest? You can now use it with Android Auto
stories.tldr: MapQuest's mapping service is now available as a beta on Android Auto, giving the once-dominant navigation brand a small comeback.

stories.title: Apple overtakes Samsung to lead European carrier smartphone sales in Q2
stories.tldr: Counterpoint Research reports Apple overtook Samsung in the second quarter of 2026 to lead smartphone sales through Europe's carrier channel.

stories.title: Formula 1 on Apple TV is getting Dolby Atmos, starting this month
stories.tldr: Apple TV's Formula 1 coverage gains Dolby Atmos sound on supported devices from the US Grand Prix weekend on October 23.

stories.title: Three Years of 80% Charge Limits on iPhone: The Results
stories.tldr: Three years after Apple added an 80 percent charge limit option to extend battery lifespan, MacRumors looks at how well it has actually worked.

stories.title: macOS 27.2 Further Hints at MacBook With Touch-Enabled OLED Display
stories.tldr: MacRumors says clues in the macOS 27.2 beta point again to a touchscreen MacBook, expected to be unveiled next month. This is a hint from software code, not a confirmed product.

stories.title: 'Pan's Labyrinth' Returns to Theaters in 3D and Dolby Atmos
stories.tldr: The team behind Guillermo del Toro's 2006 fantasy film has restored it for a new theatrical run in 3D and Dolby Atmos, looking and sounding better than ever.

stories.title: After 'Anora', Mikey Madison Craved the Restraint of 'The Social Reckoning'
stories.tldr: For her first role since winning Best Actress for 'Anora', Madison told IndieWire she was drawn to the restraint of Aaron Sorkin's take on a real person, unlike her past volatile roles.

stories.title: Andrew Garfield Helps Neon's 'Artificial' Pay Off on the Awards Front
stories.tldr: Garfield's turn in Luca Guadagnino's 'Artificial' is building an awards narrative: from corporate martyr in 'The Social Network' to corporate menace here.

stories.title: Zhang Yimou Teases Chinese 'Three-Body Problem' Movie at Busan Film Festival
stories.tldr: Director Zhang Yimou gave a glimpse of his Chinese film adaptation of 'The Three-Body Problem' at Busan's star-packed festival opening.

stories.title: Jayson Tatum explains 'totally different perspective' heading into 10th NBA season
stories.tldr: Tatum says he has a different kind of joy heading into his tenth season than he did in his first nine.

stories.title: Mike Conley on finally landing with the Celtics and being a great teammate
stories.tldr: Conley discusses joining the Celtics, his bond with Payton Pritchard, and what he has learned about being a good teammate since childhood.

stories.title: Patriots to Honor Adam Vinatieri During Halftime Ceremony on Sunday, October 11
stories.tldr: New England will celebrate Adam Vinatieri's Pro Football Hall of Fame induction at halftime against the Raiders on October 11.

stories.title: Julian Edelman on Efton Chism's catch: 'Plays like that can start a career'
stories.tldr: Edelman praised rookie Efton Chism's breakout catch against the Bills, saying it is the kind of play that can launch a career.

stories.title: Lewis Hamilton reveals full Ferrari F40 restoration in new video
stories.tldr: The seven-time champion has released the full video of his Ferrari F40 restoration, first revealed ahead of this year's Italian Grand Prix.

stories.title: Ferrari reveals visual overhaul for Charles Leclerc ahead of the Singapore GP
stories.tldr: Ferrari has dropped its usual red livery for a special-edition look on Leclerc's car, designed exclusively for the Singapore Grand Prix.

stories.title: Can Red Bull keep up their momentum after Verstappen's Sepang win?
stories.tldr: Max Verstappen has been in immense form all year, and his Sepang win showed Red Bull now has the car to match, says former F1 driver Jolyon Palmer.

stories.title: Trio of former Red Sox prospects are turning into playoff heroes for White Sox
stories.tldr: Kyle Teel, Braden Montgomery and Chase Meidroth, all acquired by Chicago in the Garrett Crochet trade, are now making a major playoff impact for the White Sox.

stories.title: Tolle lands on Pipeline's All-Rookie Team
stories.tldr: A Red Sox rookie has been named to MLB Pipeline's All-Rookie Team.

finally.title: Hannah Lim Draws on Her British-Singaporean Heritage in Sculptural Snuff Bottles
finally.tldr: Lim's sculptural snuff bottles draw on an ancient Chinese text and her British-Singaporean heritage, a quiet piece of craft worth a look.
